scope: Existing canonical Poaceae taxonomy-only evidence: accepted name, historical synonyms/ranks, cross-species varieties, genus alternative, specimen/hybrid holds. No species-card, media, genus, county, installation or Pages changes.
backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, checked 2026-10-25; primary Tripsacum cytogenetic/systematics and Texas concept studies retained as distinct authorities

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides (L.) L.
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts the existing canonical binomial in Tripsacum, Poaceae, at species rank. Original Coix epithet supplies the parenthetical L. author.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Coix dactyloides L.
scientific_decisions.reason: Homotypic basionym; preserve as searchable historical alias, not a distinct accepted learner taxon.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Dactylodes dactyloides (L.) Kuntze
scientific_decisions.reason: Homotypic historical combination, not a separate accepted species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Zea dactyloides (L.) D.L.Fu
scientific_decisions.reason: 2024 published homotypic Zea combination is recognized as a synonym, not accepted under the project's POWO/WCVP backbone.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. meridionale De Wet & Timothy
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO treats this historical variety as heterotypic synonym at species rank. Retain original varietal determinations; do not assign ploidy or South American lineage to a Texas specimen.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides subsp. hispidum Hitchc. / var. hispidum (Hitchc.) De Wet & J.R.Harlan
scientific_decisions.reason: Both historic infraspecific combinations are listed under the accepted species; original rank labels remain source provenance.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. mexicanum De Wet & J.R.Harlan
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO treats this historical variety as a synonym of the accepted species, not as a separately accepted rank.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. occidentale H.C.Cutler & E.S.Anderson
scientific_decisions.reason: Historical heterotypic variety synonym of accepted T. dactyloides.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. monostachyon (Willd.) Eaton & Wright / Tripsacum monostachyon Willd.
scientific_decisions.reason: Both names are historical heterotypic synonyms under POWO; no second species or variety card from this name alone.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. floridanum (Porter ex Vasey) Beal
scientific_decisions.reason: Historical variety explicitly maps to a different, separately accepted species; preserve source concept and prevent automatic alias to T. dactyloides.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum floridanum Porter ex Vasey
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts this at species rank, separate from T. dactyloides. Research literature also treats it as a distinct comparison species, though an alternative variety interpretation is published.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. lemmonii (Vasey) Beal
scientific_decisions.reason: Historical variety maps to a different accepted species under POWO; do not collapse it into the T. dactyloides learner.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum lanceolatum Rupr. ex E.Fourn.
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP separately accepts this species, including historical T. dactyloides var. lemmonii in synonymy.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tripsacum dactyloides var. genuinum Hack. / var. angustifolium Scribn.
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Tripsacum dactyloides (L.) L. (historical source association only)
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO explicitly flags genuinum as not validly published and angustifolium as nomen nudum; do not recognize either as valid separate accepted infraspecific taxon.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Automatic mapping of all Tripsacum dactyloides varieties to the existing dactyloides card
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: REJECTED — floridanum and lemmonii route to separate accepted species
scientific_decisions.reason: Var. floridanum is assigned to T. floridanum and var. lemmonii to T. lanceolatum; prefix matching would create false identities.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Automatic rename of Tripsacum dactyloides to Zea dactyloides, or a duplicate Zea species card
scientific_decisions.reason: The 2024 combination is an accepted nomenclatural synonym in the chosen backbone, not a new canonical species or an approved genus transfer.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Identification of individual eastern gamagrass source photos or older vouchers
scientific_decisions.reason: Accepted-name and synonym verification does not validate a photograph, historical specimen, or source labelled only Tripsacum sp.; no reassignments in taxonomy lane.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry, ploidy, and cultivar/ecotype provenance of individual canonical eastern gamagrass observations
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: NOT VERIFIED — preserve any existing scientific identity/hybrid holds
scientific_decisions.reason: Primary experiments demonstrate hybridization among Tripsacum and Zea and ploidy variation, but cannot establish hybrid status or cytotype of the learner's individual images/plants.

scientific_decisions.source_name: 2024 Zea dactyloides combination versus retained Tripsacum genus
scientific_decisions.reason: Published alternative genus circumscription exists, while POWO retains Tripsacum and comparative genomic work treats Tripsacum and Zea as sister genera; document alternative without renaming.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Texas narrow-leaved putative Tripsacum floridanum versus T. dactyloides source identifications
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: POWO retains separate accepted species; individual Texas voucher assignment unresolved
scientific_decisions.reason: McBryde (2019) discusses Texas narrow-leafed populations and argues for treating T. floridanum as a variety; do not silently reidentify individual specimens or turn this into a county nativity decision.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical var. meridionale / diploid versus tetraploid infraspecific lineage interpretation
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: POWO synonym at species rank; cytotype identity unresolved
scientific_decisions.reason: De Wet et al. (1981) and Zhu et al. (2016) retain distinguishable infraspecific or genetic lineages in research; POWO species-level synonymy does not certify the rank, lineage or ploidy of any Texas specimen.

duplicate_handling: Preserve true T. dactyloides historical synonyms as aliases; route var. floridanum to separately accepted T. floridanum and var. lemmonii to T. lanceolatum. Zea dactyloides is a homotypic synonym, not a second accepted card.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — no county nativity status changes
follow_up: Retain canonical T. dactyloides. Preserve source-voucher/photo/hybrid/ploidy holds; do not merge var. floridanum or var. lemmonii into this species. Keep published 2024 Zea alternative and Texas floridanum treatment documented, not automatically applied.
